# careberi

> careberi is a pre-licensed, non-medical home care agency serving seniors and adults with disabilities across New Jersey. It does not currently provide home health (skilled medical) care; home health services are planned for the future.

## Key facts

- Services: personal care (bathing, dressing, grooming), meals and housekeeping, medication reminders, rides and errands, companionship, memory care, 24-hour care, and respite care for family caregivers.
- Service area: New Jersey.
- Rates: $36–$50 per hour depending on the level of help and the time of day, with no minimum per visit (as of September 2026).
- How care starts: a home visit, a written care plan, and no long-term contract.
- Payment: Medicare does not pay for non-medical home care, so most families pay privately. careberi helps families file long-term care insurance claims.
- Pro bono program ("careberi care"): free caregiving hours each month for New Jersey seniors and adults with disabilities in financial hardship. Anyone can apply or nominate someone.
- Contact: 201-266-5450 (answered 24/7), care@careberi.com.
